name: VMware ESXi — Burst of Host Configuration Discovery Commands
xql_query:
dataset = vmware_esxi_raw
| filter _raw_log ~= "shell\[\d+\]: \[[^\]]+\]: " and _raw_log ~= "\]: (esxcli system settings advanced list|esxcli network firewall ruleset list|esxcli system account list|esxcli system permission list|vim-cmd vmsvc/getallvms|esxcli storage filesystem list|esxcli network ip interface list|esxcli system snmp get|vim-cmd hostsvc/hostsummary|esxcli software vib list)\s*$"
| alter esxi_host = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "^<\d+>\S+\s+(\S+)\s"), 0),
        process_name = lowercase(arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "^<\d+>\S+\s+\S+\s+([A-Za-z_-]+)"), 0)),
        process_id = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "^<\d+>\S+\s+\S+\s+[^\[]*?\[(\d+)\]"), 0),
        event_id = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Event (\d+) :"), 0),
        host_ip = _final_reporting_device_ip,
        message = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "^<\d+>\S+\s+\S+\s+(.*)$"), 0)
| alter actor_user = coalesce(
            arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "\suser=([^\s\]]+)"), 0),
            arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "shell\[\d+\]: \[([^\]]+)\]: "), 0),
            arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, " by ([^\s@]+)@\d"), 0),
            arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Accepted \S+ for (?:user )?(\S+) from"), 0),
            arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "USER (\S+) pid \d+ cmd"), 0)),
        src_ip = coalesce(
            arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "@(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0),
            arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "from (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0),
            arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "rhost=(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0),
            arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "envoy-access\[\d+\]: .*? (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+):\d+ HTTP/"), 0)),
        src_port = coalesce(
            arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "from \S+ port (\d+)"), 0),
            arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "envoy-access\[\d+\]: .*? \d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+:(\d+) HTTP/"), 0))
| alter app_protocol = if(process_name = "sshd-session", "ssh",
                       if(process_name in ("hostd", "envoy-access"), "https",
                       if(process_name = "shell", "esxi-shell", null))),
        host_service_port = if(process_name = "sshd-session", "22",
                            if(process_name in ("hostd", "envoy-access"), "443", null)),
        event_action = null, target_account = null, command_or_path = null,
        target_object = null, external_target = null
| alter geo_ip = if(src_ip != null and not (incidr(src_ip, "10.0.0.0/8") or incidr(src_ip, "172.16.0.0/12") or incidr(src_ip, "192.168.0.0/16") or incidr(src_ip, "127.0.0.0/8")), src_ip, "0.0.0.0")
| iploc geo_ip loc_country as src_country
| alter command_or_path = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "shell\[\d+\]: \[[^\]]+\]: (.+)$"), 0), event_action = "discovery command"
| bin _time span = 10m
| comp count() as event_count,
       values(actor_user) as actor_users,
       values(src_ip) as src_ips,
       values(src_country) as src_countries,
       values(src_port) as src_ports,
       values(process_name) as process_names,
       values(process_id) as process_ids,
       values(event_id) as event_ids,
       values(event_action) as event_actions,
       values(target_account) as target_accounts,
       values(command_or_path) as commands_paths,
       values(target_object) as target_objects,
       values(external_target) as external_targets,
       values(app_protocol) as app_protocols,
       values(host_service_port) as host_service_ports,
       values(message) as events_seen,
       count_distinct(command_or_path) as distinct_commands
       by esxi_host, host_ip, _time
| filter distinct_commands >= 6
| fields esxi_host, host_ip, actor_users, src_ips, src_countries, src_ports, host_service_ports, process_names, process_ids, event_ids, event_actions, target_accounts, commands_paths, target_objects, external_targets, app_protocols, events_seen, event_count
description: Six or more different host configuration discovery commands (accounts, permissions, firewall, network, storage, SNMP, VIBs) ran within 10 minutes.
alert_name: VMware ESXi — Burst of Host Configuration Discovery Commands on $esxi_host
alert_description:
What fired: Six or more different host configuration discovery commands (accounts, permissions, firewall, network, storage, SNMP, VIBs) ran within 10 minutes.

Why it matters: Scripted harvesting of the whole host configuration is reconnaissance before privilege abuse or encryption; monitoring runs only a few of these. Assessed severity: Low.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1082 - System Information Discovery; T1087.001 - Account Discovery: Local Account (TA0007 - Discovery).

Investigate:
  - Read events_seen for the exact host log lines and the acting user / source.
  - Confirm with the ESXi owner whether the change or access was planned (change ticket, maintenance window).
  - Pivot on the alert's key (esxi_host) and the source IP to firewall, VPN, and identity activity in the same window.
  - Check the same host for other ESXi alerts (shell enabled, uncommon commands, syslog changes, VM power-offs) that would make this part of a ransomware chain.
